title: Real-PDF outline reader and writer bridge
acceptance: cargo test -p pdfxi-edit; a real fixture outline round-trips (read -> edit -> write -> PDFium reopen) and a document without /Outlines gains one on add; malformed outlines are typed errors, not panics
notes: Library slice split out of T-0255 after the app lane found that pdfxi_edit::navigation has an id-based Outline/BookmarkSummary model and outline_to_dict, but no bridge to a real pdfxi_core::Document. Reads the catalog /Outlines tree, resolves /Dest and /A page references to zero-based page indexes (including named destinations when the document provides them), builds BookmarkSummary/Outline, and writes an edited Outline back as the catalog /Outlines with /Parent /First /Last /Next /Prev and real page references. Creates /Outlines on first add when absent; reports a malformed tree with a typed error. Tests on the real fixtures: read -> add/rename/move -> write -> reopen with PDFium and assert the order/titles/pages; no-outlines case; malformed case. The app panel and properties dialog remain T-0255.
